sum: Bragg Gaming Group Inc. operates as an iGaming content and technology solutions. The company offers Bragg PAM, a player account management platform; Bragg HUB, an iGaming product delivery solution; and Fuze, a gamification and engagement toolset. It also offers casino content, and marketing and operational services. The company operates in Malta, the Netherlands, the United States, Brazil, Curaçao, Marshall Islands, Belgium, Croatia, Isle of Man, Czech Republic, and internationally. The company was formerly known as Rockies Financial Corporation and changed its name to Bragg Gaming Group Inc. in 2018. Bragg Gaming Group Inc. is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
